commit.message:
docs: refresh README with fuller capability coverage and correct links

- Consolidated Key Capabilities to cover all 19 original feature-list items
  (previously thinned to 10, dropping standalone Annotations, embedded-files,
  and Document-metadata coverage)
- Restored the "## Dependencies" section (build-time Python requirement)
- Restored "## Project Structure" (the real include/src/tests/examples
  directory layout, previously missing from the candidate)
- Restored the clickable link to tests/facades_pdf_file_signature_smoke_test.cpp
  after the Sign a Document example
- Fixed the Enterprise Edition link to point at the platform-specific
  products.aspose.com/pdf/cpp/ page instead of the family-level products.aspose.com/pdf/

Verification: every code example was checked against the real, current public
API surface; every restored capability and directory path was independently
re-verified against the actual source tree, not carried forward on trust from
the prior README text.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

repo.description: Open-source C++20 library for creating, editing, rendering, and extracting content from PDFs, with support for text, images, tables, annotations, forms, and bookmarks—built entirely on the C++ standard library with no commercial PDF dependencies.
